# AI CORE

> AI CORE (https://cloudaicore.com) is a personal AI avatar and workspace by SYNCHRON-X. Every person gets their own avatar with controlled memory, tasks and connections (Google, GitHub, video). The AI suggests, the person approves. Interface in Bulgarian and English. Free start without a credit card.

## Main pages

- [Home and sign-up](https://cloudaicore.com/): what AI CORE does and how to start for free
- [Plans](https://cloudaicore.com/plans): free daily chat, AI units for heavier work, no automatic extra charges
- [Help](https://cloudaicore.com/help): how to use the avatar, memory, tasks and connections
- [Developers](https://cloudaicore.com/developers): MCP server at https://cloudaicore.com/mcp with OAuth, for Claude and other AI clients
- [Blog](https://cloudaicore.com/blog/): articles about AI CORE in several languages
- [Status](https://cloudaicore.com/status): live service status

## Key facts

- Each user has their own avatar and data; nothing is shared between accounts.
- Actions that change things (email, calendar, code) need the person's one-time approval.
- Models: Claude by default, with OpenAI, Gemini and Grok as extra engines and a side-by-side comparison.
- Privacy: https://cloudaicore.com/privacy · Terms: https://cloudaicore.com/terms
